title: Manager prep Q2 2026 - Noelle Simpson
content:
Purpose: notes for upcoming 1:1 with manager (May 22), prep for calibration / promotion conversation in Q3. Rough, keep as scratchpad.

Quick wins (Q1-Q2):
- Reduced time-to-hire for IC roles from 36 -> 28 days by standardizing interview loop + scorecard. Metric tracked in hiring tracker (see Confluence).
- Launched new onboarding checklist + buddy program for infra/product hires; NPS pilot = 4.3/5 (n=24).
- Rolled out compensation calibration template to two teams; helped identify 6 out-of-band increases.

Areas to raise with manager:
- Headcount ask for H2: need +2 Sr People Ops (recruiter + program manager) to support Dedicated/Private expansions. Rationale: hiring velocity, candidate sourcer shortage, and increased enterprise onboarding needs.
- Budget/comp tradeoffs for Q3: propose reallocation of external training to candidate experience budget.
- Support on cross-functional roadmap: product requires dedicated onboarding support for Dedicated customers (pilot). Request 0.1 FTE from product ops or PM time.

Career / promotion thoughts:
- Been owning end-to-end hiring metrics and onboarding improvements for 18 months; influence across eng, product, and sales.
- Examples of leadership: led cross-functional task force for onboarding automation, presented at all-hands, mentored two junior POs now promoted.
- Development areas: compensation modeling (need more hands-on with finance data), strategic influence at exec-level (want coaching).
- Target: promotion to Sr People Ops in Q4 2026 if hiring need confirmed and measurable impact continued (reduce attrition by 3% YTD, improve new hire ramp by 2 weeks).

Conversation bullets for 1:1 (May 22):
- Quick status: hiring metrics, onboarding NPS, open reqs (prioritize which to push).
- Ask for budget headcount approval timeline and next steps.
- Request managerial feedback: is my scope aligning with expectations for Sr level? What evidence would be decisive?
- Ask for 1:1 sponsorship to present the Dedicated onboarding pilot to the GTM execs (target June 8).
- Discuss mentorship/coaching options (recommend external coach + biweekly skip-levels).

Evidence/examples to share with manager:
- Hiring funnel dashboard (link to Confluence page).
- Onboarding NPS raw responses (anonymized summaries).
- 2x case studies where checklist reduced time-to-first-contribution.
- Feedback excerpts from hiring managers and new hires (copy/paste short quotes).

Risks / blockers:
- Recruiter capacity: current TA partner bandwidth is 0.6 FTE; pipeline fragile for infra roles.
- Platform changes: Dedicated product timeline shifting could increase onboarding work by 30%.
- Finance constraints for comp adjustments if we need out-of-cycle increases.

Requests (concrete):
- Headcount: hiring req for Senior Recruiter + Program Manager (outline JD draft in Confluence).
- Exec visibility: 15 min on GTM leadership sync (June 8) to request pilot resources.
- Coaching: budget for external career coach (est. $6k).

Notes to self / TODOs post 1:1:
- Send follow-up with prioritized req list and hiring timeline.
- Share NPS highlights and case studies with manager and Aisha.
- Draft promotion packet (evidence + 3 concrete projects) for review by June 30.
- Book intro with potential external coach; ask for manager approval on budget.

Open questions / things to research:
- What is the current compensation band for Sr People Ops (prod vs eng-aligned)? (ask Finance/Comp).
- Can we get additional analytics support to measure 90-day ramp more precisely?
- Who owns Dedicated customer onboarding in GTM org? (trace owners and include in pilot).

Scratch notes (quick, informal):
- "Bring up candidate sourcer shortage — small contract sourcers for infra-only roles worked well last quarter."
- "Ask for manager to introduce me to head of product ops re: Dedicated pilot."
- "Keep promotion ask high-level now; wait for data until mid-June."

Related links: Confluence Q2 OKRs (linked), hiring funnel dashboard, onboarding NPS sheet, JD drafts in /people-ops/jd-drafts.

Status: draft — will tidy after 1:1 and attach artifacts.
